subject.title: feat(browser): type secrets from env vars via {{env:KEY}} placeholders

question: Should the browser tool accept model-authored `{{env:KEY}}` placeholders that resolve to operator env SecretRefs, and if so must that path require explicit configured allowlists plus scoped redaction before merge?
rationale: This creates a new browser credential-delivery boundary that can expose process environment secrets unless maintainers choose and enforce the exact security contract.

options.title: Require explicit allowlist and scoped redaction
options.body: Reject placeholder resolution unless the selected env provider is explicitly configured with an allowlist containing every requested key, then redact every browser output path with lifecycle-scoped state before merge.

options.title: Accept broader env typing intentionally
options.body: Maintainers could allow implicit or unallowlisted env typing, but that would need explicit security-model approval, docs, and real proof.

options.title: Move the capability out of this branch
options.body: If this belongs in a managed-browser integration or different plugin seam, pause or close this PR and request a narrower external implementation path.

recommendation.title: Require explicit allowlist and scoped redaction
recommendation.body: Reject placeholder resolution unless the selected env provider is explicitly configured with an allowlist containing every requested key, then redact every browser output path with lifecycle-scoped state before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The core unresolved choice depends on SecretRef env-provider semantics and allowlist behavior that this owner previously shaped.
